palette: Totoy 36, hard alpha; no reserved gold x,y or red z,A
scale: 1x game pixels (nearest-neighbour; preview sheets are scaled copies)
status: Reference art for the human's approval; NOT imported into art/src, not in art/build, not wired into the game
frame_naming: <group>_<n>, n from 1; mirror around the anchor for a left-facing hero, as with the hero frames
aspect: Echo Step (suggested display name: ECHO STEP; subtitle idea: 'A STEP LEFT BEHIND')
request: Totoy leaves a glowing afterimage (the echo) where he stands, then moves and acts freely; after about 2 s he is pulled back to the echo, teleporting to it, with a brief invulnerable moment on arrival. Duration, cooldown and i-frames are owner/core decisions.

groups.fx_echo_place_<1..5>: 48x48, anchor (24,42) = Totoy's feet where he places the echo. Over the hero: 1 flash + column, 2 the ring opens and the echo forms, 3 overshoot with bright runes, 4 settle, 5 calm. Then loop fx_echo_anchor.
groups.fx_echo_anchor_<1..6>: 48x48, anchor (24,42) = the echo's feet (fixed world point). The echo: a dithered lilac/teal ghost of Totoy's idle pose on a teal rune ring (the ring's back half is drawn behind the ghost, its front half in front), a scanline crawls down it, motes rise. Loop about 100 ms. Sort with characters by its ground y.
groups.fx_echo_countdown_<1..4>: 48x48, anchor (24,42). Replaces the anchor loop for the last ~20 ticks before the recall (4 x 80 ms = 320 ms): the ring tightens and flickers bright, the echo flickers thin, ticks close in.
groups.fx_echo_vanish_<1..5>: 48x48, anchor (24,42) = where Totoy stood when the recall fires. The hero is NOT drawn here: 1 a column of light, 2 it pinches to a line, 3 it breaks upward, 4-5 motes.
groups.fx_echo_trail_h|d|v_<1..4>: The recall streak, tiled from the departure point to the echo. h: 16x8, anchor (0,4) on the line, repeat every 16 px along +x. d: 16x16 45-degree (down-right), anchor (0,0), repeat every (16,16). v: 8x16, anchor (4,0), repeat every 16 px along +y. For other angles rotate the h tile around its anchor (nearest filtering) or mirror h/d/v. Phases 1-4 are the streak's life (flash, flow, break, motes), not a loop; draw at chest height (feet - 14).
groups.fx_echo_trail_head_<1..4>: 16x16, anchor (8,8). The comet head at the echo end of the streak (chest height), same phases as the trail.
groups.fx_echo_arrive_<1..5>: 48x48, anchor (24,42) = the echo's feet. 1 the echo flares white and streaks pull in (the echo itself stops here), 2 flash + ring (Totoy is drawn at the echo from this frame), 3 the ring opens, 4 broken ring, 5 motes.
groups.fx_echo_bubble_<1..4>: 40x48, anchor (20,44) = Totoy's feet. Generic invulnerability shield over ANY hero frame: dithered bubble rim with a glint sweeping round it, 4 fading. Start with fx_echo_arrive_2; loop 1-3 while the i-frames last, end on 4.
groups.fx_echo_shield_<hero frame>_<1..4>: Alternative to the bubble: a water-white outline hugging the exact hero frame with a glint running down it, cropped (anchor = the hero frame's feet in the crop). See the naming rule in the README. Covered: idle 1-4, walk 1-6, dash 1-4 of hero2, totoy_dagger and totoy_scythe.
groups.fx_echo_dust_<1..5>: 32x16, anchor (16,12) = feet. Pale dust kicked out at placement, departure and arrival.

suggested_timeline: cast: fx_echo_place 1-5 over Totoy (+ fx_echo_dust), then fx_echo_anchor loop at that point. ~2 s later minus 320 ms: fx_echo_countdown 1-4. Recall: fx_echo_vanish 1-5 at Totoy's position (hero hidden), trail h/d/v + head 1-4 from there to the echo, fx_echo_arrive 1-5 at the echo (anchor stops at arrive 1; hero drawn at the echo from arrive 2), fx_echo_bubble (or shield) 1-3 looping during i-frames, then 4, fx_echo_dust at arrive 2.
